description.value: B&T's Hard Knock Cafe is a breakfast-to-late-night restaurant and live music venue in the heart of Rossland, BC, operated by owners Bono and Ty since 2023. It serves hearty breakfasts, pub-style dinners, and craft beer alongside a rotating calendar of live bands, karaoke, and open mic nights. Touring cyclists will find a laid-back, community-rooted spot with a full menu ranging from morning fuel to evening pints.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms B&T's Hard Knock Cafe is an active restaurant and live music venue at 2024 Columbia Ave, Rossland, BC, with upcoming events listed for May 29-30, 2026 and a reopening announcement from May 13, 2026 after a seasonal closure. The menu explicitly labels a 'Vegetarian Hash Bowl' and the site features an 'Order Online' navigation link confirming takeout capability. No bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: Business appears to operate seasonally with at least one documented closure period; cyclists should verify current operating status before visiting.
No phone number present in OSM tags or anywhere on the website.
